crossRefs.note: When he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out, and say, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”
and came and lived in a city called Nazareth; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets that he…

Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, wrote: Jesus…

translations.web: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him, and said, “You were also with the Nazarene, Jesus!”
translations.bsb: and saw him warming himself there. She looked at Peter and said, “You also were with Jesus the Nazarene.”
translations.kjv: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.
translations.asv: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and saith, Thou also wast with the Nazarene, even Jesus.
